verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a publishable, hosted Trust Center with custom domain and branding. Its control-monitoring data is pulled continuously, so control status stays live, and admins choose what to display. Visitors can self-serve or request sensitive documents, and admins approve or deny requests and enforce an NDA. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that certifications and audit reports are shown as badges or downloads, confirmation that the NDA is a click-through flow rather than admin-gated approval, evidence it shortens or prevents security reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
